name: astra-advisor
description: Codex-native dynamic orchestration with user-configurable model preferences.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, route, verify, and review work with your preferred models.
interface.longDescription: Astra Advisor preserves the user's selected parent model and effort. It combines useful parent work with bounded native Codex subagents, applying user and AGENTS.md routing preferences before optional plugin defaults. Model and effort choices remain limited by live tool capabilities. A delegation hook advises on missing explicit controls without blocking or rewriting calls. ChatGPT Work cloud tasks remain bounded by the create_thread schema and do not promise arbitrary model or effort pinning.
defaultPrompt: Use $astra-advisor:orchestration to plan, build, verify, and review this work.
Choose dynamic subagents only when bounded independent work improves delivery.
